main.description: Fetch a content-addressed MUXL playback blob by CID. Serves either a primary fMP4 archive or a per-track init segment — both are CID-addressed and indistinguishable from the endpoint's point of view. HTTP `Range` headers are honored; HLS media playlists generated by getVideoPlaylist reference this endpoint with `EXT-X-BYTERANGE` to serve segments out of the primary blob.

cid.description: BLAKE-3 BDASL CID of the requested blob.

errors.name: BlobNotFound
errors.description: This node doesn't have the requested CID. The caller should consult place.stream.media.origin records to find a node that does.
